label: exploratory
description: Burn-in length check: A0 only, 18 planned cells, 2 seeds (311-312, disjoint from EXP-002 seeds), T = t_d = 2000, no shock. Compares phi over steps [400, 500) with phi over [1900, 2000) to see whether the planned 500-step burn-in reaches a stationary state. Exploratory.
